newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RICHTER ISSUE PRICE $78 OR HUF 14,160-MTI.
newsitem.headline: RICHTER ISSUE PRICE $78 OR HUF 14,160-MTI.

text.p: The issue price in shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Vegyeszeti Gyar Rt was set at $78 or 14,160 forints per share, Hungarian news agency MTI said on Thursday.
The 2.6 million shares offered privately was 4.5 times oversubscribed, MTI said.
Of the 2.6 million shares, 1.6 million was offered by Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt, while one million shares are new ones issued by Richter.
The placement for institutional investors will be followed by the domestic public offer by APV of 200,000 shares, for which subscription will start on May 27.
On Thursday on the Budapest Stock Exchange Richter shares closed at 14,240 forints, down 215.
